name: fleet-image
description: The session image: its Dockerfile, which `fleet setup image` builds, the folders of a container that are fleet's own (layout), and what the image carries at /opt/fleet: fleet-box's helper, which serves a session container's files and processes to the host from inside it; fleet-tau's TypeScript runner, which type-checks and runs the model's programs there with ts-executor; fleet's implementations of the APIs a tau declares, which those programs import as @api/<name>; and the `tau` command, which runs a tau from the model's commands through the implementation of the API of that name. The layout and each part's protocol module are shared with the host

scripts.test: node -e "for (const path of ['lib', 'tsconfig.tsbuildinfo']) require('node:fs').rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -b && node --test "lib/**/*.test.js"
